title: deal-velocity-touchpoint-cadence-liam-ops-notes
body:
Quick prep notes for weekly cross-functional touchpoint. Goal: clear blockers that are slowing deal velocity, confirm next steps for renewal engagement, escalate any infra/ops showstoppers.

Context / snapshot:
- Account: AsterCloud (mid-market, fintech). Current commit: 40% of expected usage; renewal window in 10 weeks.
- Primary stakeholders: Alex (AE), Priya (Head of ML), Tomas (infra), our SE: Ravi. CSM sponsor changed last month (onboarding lag).
- Key metric: trial-to-paid conversion velocity, currently 3.2 weeks (target 2 weeks).
- Recent event: SLA questions on private deployment latency (customer benchmark test failed at 95th p99).

Things to surface in sync (brain dump):
- Why did benchmark fail? stack trace from perf test (ask Ravi for raw logs).
- Where are we on the small scope POC items? (auth, KMS integr, model pinning).
- Finance: procurement timeline slipped (legal redlines). Anything AE can unblock?
- Reference architecture doc overdue — need to ship EOD Fri so they can test 2nd cluster.

Open questions to ask AE/CSM/SE during meeting:
- AE (Camila): What are top 2 negotiation points blocking the signature? (price vs timeline vs entitlements)
- CSM (Ava): Who owns recurring check-ins at customer side? Are they prepared to run perf test with our checklist?
- SE (Ravi): Can you isolate whether failure is kernel selection (quantization path) vs infra network jitter? Any short-term workaround?

Suggested agenda (5/30 min cadence) — keep flexible:
1) Quick status + one-line wins (3m)
2) Perf test findings & immediate mitigation plan (10m)
3) Contract/procurement blockers and ask list for AE (7m)
4) Implementation milestones: who-does-what by when (7m)
5) Risks & escalation plan if we miss renewal (3m)
6) Action items recap (end)

Quick talking points to use when nudging customer:
- "We can ship the reference infra doc by Friday; can you commit to a window next week to run the test with our checklist?"
- "If the perf anomaly is infra-level, we can propose a targeted dedicated run with kernel X — it should show ~30% improvement for your seq lengths."
- "To keep the renewal on track, we need an updated PO commitment timeline; what would be a reasonable internal date?"

Unresolved risks (notes to self):
- Legal redlines: data residency clause still pending. Need legal consult before next Friday. (Action: ping legal, cc: Camila).
- Onboarding bandwidth: customer CS lead stepping down next month — need backup contact.
- Potential price pushback if they ask for additional SLA guarantees.

Immediate action items to assign in meeting (template):
- Ravi -> triage perf logs, attach filtered traces to JIRA-4521, due: 2026-03-05
- Camila -> escalate procurement calendar to finance contact (Ana), propose two PO dates, due: 2026-03-08
- Ava -> confirm customer-side test owner and share runbook, due: 2026-03-04
- Liam (me) -> draft reference infra doc and hand to SE for review, due: 2026-03-06

Notes-to-self / coaching cues for AE:
- Be explicit about "gap list" we can close post-signature vs must-have pre-signature.
- Use urgency anchor: highlight expected impact to their product roadmap if we delay (quantify where possible).

Follow-up cadence after sync (proposal):
- Weekly 30m until signature, then biweekly until implementation complete.
- Shared tracker (simple sheet) with three columns: blocker / owner / target date. Keep it lightweight.

Rough script snippets (for quick copy):
- Opening: "Appreciate the time — want to clear the last few blockers so you can hit your internal deadline. Two asks from our side: run the perf checklist next week; confirm PO date."
- On perf: "We believe this is a kernel selection mismatch; Ravi will run a limited repro and share a PRN within 48h."

Random notes & crumbs (messy):
- Tomas: asked about HSM options; add to infra doc section 3b.
- They asked about SSO mapping -> include SCIM notes.
- Might need to propose a short paid pilot for the extra cluster time (cost to cover infra burst).

End of prep. Will update after meeting with outcomes and adjust owners/dates.
quick_actions: Ping legal re: data residency (include summary paragraph)
Share draft infra doc with SE by EOD Fri
Set calendar for weekly 30m until signature
follow_up_notes: If perf repro shows network jitter, schedule 1h deep-dive with infra team
If procurement misses date, escalate to sales ops for gating approval
Track SCIM/SSO asks as part of post-signature backlog if not required for go-live
